Hi Olivia —

Quick summary of where things stand ahead of the Dec renewal: attached is a 90-day usage + performance snapshot (redwood-90d-usage-dashboard.pdf). High level:

- 90-day moving avg run-rate: ~1.2B tokens/month (production inference for search + chat).
- Recent 30-day spike to 1.6B tokens driven by A/B experiment traffic; sustained baseline remains ~1.25B.
- Effective unit cost (hosted + caching): ~$0.0017 per token (~$1.70 / 1k tokens).
- P95 latency (prod, eu-us cross region): 220ms currently; P99 near 420ms during peak bursts.
- Cache hit rate: 12% across conversational prefixes; batching yields 8–15% token reduction depending on seq len.

We ran two renewal/expansion scenarios that typically match what customers ask for:

1) Stabilize (6-month extension + 20% commit uplift)
   - Commit: 1.44B tokens/month
   - Discounted unit price: $1.45 / 1k (~14% effective savings)
   - Expected operations: keep hosted routing; no dedicated nodes required; marginal latency improvement from higher batch opportunities.

2) Scale & SLA (12-month term + 50% commit + Dedicated capacity burst pool)
   - Commit: 1.8B tokens/month
   - Discounted unit price: $1.20 / 1k (~29% effective savings)
   - Includes: reserved GPU pool for peak windows, 99.9% availability SLA, P95 target 150ms with routing policy pinned to dedicated nodes.
   - Requires onboarding for Dedicated (2–3 week ops lead time) and an addendum for SLA/uptime credits.

Estimated customer-facing ROI (based on your measurement of 0.6% retention lift per 100ms latency reduction):
- Scenario 1: small cost savings, limited latency gains => marginal revenue impact but lowers unit cost immediately.
- Scenario 2: larger cost savings + improved UX => projected +2.1% revenue uplift over 12 months (conservative).

Next steps I recommend:
- Confirm which scenario you want modeled in the order form (we can produce a month-by-month cashflow and break-even analysis).
- If you want 150ms P95 as a hard SLA, we should schedule a 30-minute ops sync to scope dedicated pool sizing (Ben can lead technical order-of-ops).

Attached: redwood-90d-usage-dashboard.pdf (dashboard export), and a stub order form I'll populate on confirmation.

Thanks — happy to walk through numbers live.

—Jordan
